scope: updex/catalog_test.go snapshot restore mode tests, internal/testutil TrustedTempDir
correction: t.TempDir() creates its directory with mode 0777 under the caller's umask, so under umask 0002 it is group-writable, and dirmode.MkdirAll leaves a directory it creates there at the umask mode by design. A test that pins a dirmode.MkdirAll mode needs a 0755 parent (testutil.TrustedTempDir) or must set its umask before the first t.TempDir().
